connection_string.description: The blob storage container's connection string.

container_name.description: The name of the blob container.

source_file_type.description: The file type of the source files. Supported file types are `CSV` and `PARQUET`.

storage_account_name.description: The name of the Azure Storage account.

sync_all_versions.description: Specify if all versions of the records should be synced. If set to `true`, all versions of the records will be synced. If set to `false`, only the latest version of the records will be synced.

client_id.description: `Client ID` of your Microsoft client application.

client_secret.description: `Client Secret` of your Microsoft client application.

tenant_id.description: `Tenant ID` of your Microsoft client application.
